meta.title: ResumeCraft — Resume builder
meta.description: Create a professional resume with 12 templates, live preview, and PDF or Word download. Your drafts stay in your browser.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The address may be wrong, or the page has moved.

footer.label: Footer
footer.local: No account. Your resumes are saved in this browser.

export.title: Export resume
export.browserNote: Chrome and Edge give the most accurate result. Other browsers may handle page size differently, so check the print preview.
export.failed: The PDF could not be prepared. Please try again.

about.pdf: Your browser makes the PDF. Pressing the button opens its print window, and the file is saved only when you choose Save as PDF there. Text stays sharp and selectable.
about.json: Downloads directly. A backup holds this resume and its version history, including earlier wording, and can be imported into ResumeCraft later. It is not meant to be sent to employers.
about.docx: Downloads directly. An editable Word file with the same text, sections and links in a plain one-column layout. It does not copy the template’s design, so open it and check the page breaks.
about.letterDocx: Downloads directly. An editable Word file with your details, date, recipient and letter text. Open it and check the page breaks.

export.paperOnce: Used for this download only. The design setting is unchanged.

chromium.two: Check the paper size is {size}, margins “Default” and scale 100%.
chromium.three: Turn “Headers and footers” off, then press Save.

safari.one: Pick paper size {size}. Safari may not set it for you.
safari.three: Open the PDF menu, choose “Save as PDF” and pick a folder.

firefox.two: Check the paper size is {size} and scale is 100%.
firefox.three: Turn off “Print headers and footers”, then press Save.

ios.one: In the print options, check the paper size is {size}.
ios.two: Tap the share button, or pinch open the page preview and then share.

android.one: Choose “Save as PDF” as the printer.
android.three: Tap the PDF button and choose where to save.

export.docxFailed: The Word file could not be created. Please try again.

hero.title: Your next chapter starts here.
hero.body: Create a professional resume that reflects your experience, your ambitions and your next opportunity.
hero.note: Free to use. No account. No watermark.
hero.caption: The editor, shown with sample content.

showcase.title: Twelve layouts, each with its own structure
showcase.intro: Change template at any time. Your text moves with you.

editing.title: See the page as you write
editing.body: What you see in the preview is what gets exported. Try a colour, a typeface or another layout here.
editing.preview: Real pages that break the way the PDF will
editing.undo: Undo and redo, plus saved versions you can return to

writing.title: Writing help that waits for your approval
writing.body: Optional tools built on Google Gemini. Everything else works without them.

rewrite.title: Edit in place
rewrite.body: Tighten, correct or restructure a description, then compare it with your original.

tailor.title: Match a job advert
tailor.body: See which requirements your resume shows, and make a tailored copy.

letter.title: Draft a cover letter
letter.body: Start from your resume and the role, or write it yourself.

import.title: Bring an old resume
import.body: Read a PDF or Word file on your device and review it before anything is created.

writing.rules: Suggestions are never applied automatically. New numbers that you did not write are rejected, but check every suggestion: automated checks cannot catch every mistake.

privacy.title: Your resume stays with you
privacy.body: There is no account and no database. Drafts live in this browser, so keep a backup.

device.title: On this device
device.files: PDF and Word files you import or export

sent.title: Sent to Gemini only when you ask
sent.ask: Nothing is sent until you agree.
sent.only: Only the text needed for the tool you chose.
sent.excluded: Writing tools leave out your name, email, phone, address, links, photo and referees.

export.title: Ready to send
export.body: Download from the same page layout you edited.
export.pdf: PDF in A4 or US Letter with selectable text and working links, saved through your browser’s print window
export.word: An editable Word document in a simple single-column layout
export.ats: Single-column templates and a check that explains what hiring software may miss

choose.title: Choose your template
choose.body: Filter by layout, photo support or how easily hiring software can read it.

add.title: Add your experience
add.body: Work through one section at a time. Changes save as you type.

download.title: Customise and download
download.body: Adjust colour, type and spacing, then export a PDF or Word file.

final.title: Start with a blank page that already looks finished
final.body: Pick a template and add your first role.

settings.title: Settings
settings.themeNote: Affects the app only. Resume colours are set in each resume.
settings.languageNote: Your resume text is not translated.

settings.storedNote: Kept in this browser’s local database.
settings.usage: This site uses about {size} MB of browser storage.
settings.deleteAllNote: Removes every resume, version, cover letter and preference stored by this app in this browser.
settings.deleteAllBody: {count, plural, =0 {Your cover letters and preferences will be removed.} one {# resume, its versions, your cover letters and preferences will be removed.} other {# resumes, their versions, your cover letters and preferences will be removed.}} This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteFailed: The data could not be deleted. Close other tabs of this app and try again.

privacy.local: Resumes, cover letters, photos and preferences are stored in your browser. This app has no accounts and no resume database.
privacy.loss: Clearing site data, using a private window or losing the device removes your resumes. Keep a backup file.
privacy.aiSend: AI features need an internet connection. After you agree, the text for a request passes through this site’s server to Google Gemini, which processes it under Google’s terms. This app does not save or log that text.
privacy.noTracking: There are no advertising or analytics trackers, and resume data is never placed in cookies.

start.title: Create a resume
start.intro: Choose how you want to begin. You can change everything later.
start.name: Resume name
start.languageHint: Sets the section headings and date format.
start.example: Fill with fictional example text, to try the editor
start.guidedBody: The assistant turns your answers into a draft you can check and edit.

dnd.instructions: To reorder, press space to pick up, use the arrow keys to move, press space to drop or escape to cancel.

editor.heading: Editing {title}
editor.changeTemplateNote: Your text is kept. Colours and fonts reset to the new template’s defaults, and you can undo.

missing.title: Resume not found
missing.body: It may have been deleted, or created in a different browser.

storage.title: This resume cannot be opened

editor.emptyHidden: Empty fields do not appear in your resume.
editor.hiddenNotice: This section is hidden from your resume.
editor.sectionGone: This section no longer exists. Choose another one.
editor.duplicateFailed: The copy could not be saved.

shortcuts.note: These work in the editor. Fields in the assistant keep your browser’s own undo.

saveProblem.loadStored: Discard mine and load the other

errors.url: Enter a web address, such as example.com.
errors.dateOrder: The end date is before the start date.

photo.hint: JPG, PNG or WebP up to 8 MB. It is cropped to a square and stays on your device.

photo.type: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
photo.size: The image is larger than 8 MB.
photo.decode: That image could not be read.

form.richHint: Start a line with “- ” for a bullet. Use **bold** and *italic*.
form.removeSectionBody: “{name}” and everything in it will be removed. You can undo this.

design.title: Design
design.intro: Changes apply to this resume only.
design.contrastNote: This colour is faint on white paper and may be hard to read or print.
design.noPhotoYet: Add a photo under Personal details.
design.photoUnsupported: This template is designed without a photo. Choose another template to include one.
design.languageHint: Changes headings and dates. Your own text is not translated.
design.targetRoleHint: Used by the assistant. It is not printed.

ai.title: Assistant
ai.taskLabel: What do you want help with?
ai.unavailableBody: No Gemini API key is configured for this site. You can still write, design, check and download your resume.
ai.consentBody: When you use an AI feature, the text that request needs is sent through this site’s server to Google Gemini, which processes it under Google’s terms.
ai.consentExcluded: Your name, contact details, links, photo and references are left out of resume text. Anything you type into a question or description is sent as written.

errors.not-configured: The AI service is not set up correctly on this site. The API key or model name needs attention.
errors.invalid-request: That request could not be accepted. Try a shorter text.
errors.forbidden: The request was blocked. Reload the page and try again.
errors.rate-limited: Too many requests. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.quota: The AI usage limit has been reached. Try again later. Your resume is not affected.
errors.timeout: Gemini took too long to answer.
errors.bad-response: Gemini returned an answer that could not be used.
errors.unverified: The suggestion added figures that are not in your text, so it was rejected.
errors.upstream: The AI service is not responding. Try again shortly.
errors.network: Could not connect. Check your internet connection.
errors.daily-limit: You have reached today’s AI limit on this device. It resets tomorrow.
errors.invalid-key: Gemini rejected the API key. The site owner needs to check GEMINI_API_KEY.
errors.model-unavailable: The configured Gemini model is not available. The site owner needs to check GEMINI_MODEL.
errors.blocked: Gemini would not answer for this text. Reword it, then try again.
errors.too-long: The answer was too long to finish. Try again with a shorter text.

suggestion.stale: You have edited this text since the suggestion was written. Accepting replaces your newer version.

email.title: Email
email.pass: A valid email address is present.

summary.title: Summary

symbols.title: Symbols and emoji
symbols.warn: Emoji or picture symbols may be lost or garbled when software reads the file. Use plain text.

khmer.title: Khmer text
khmer.warn: Khmer displays correctly, but software may not read Khmer out of a PDF accurately. This has not been verified. For online forms, consider an English copy or the Word export.
khmer.fail: Check how Khmer text is read.

ats.limitsTitle: What this check cannot tell you

limits.guess: It is a fixed set of rules. No score guarantees your resume will pass an employer’s system.
limits.systems: Hiring systems differ, and none of them was tested here.
limits.words: Keywords are matched as words and common spellings, not by meaning.
limits.files: It reads your resume data, not the exported file. To check a PDF, copy its text into a blank note and read it.

intro.choose: Bring in a resume you already have. You check every detail before anything is saved.
intro.organise: This is the text found in your file. Choose how to sort it into resume fields.
intro.review: Sorting is never perfect. Compare with your original and fix anything that is in the wrong place.

import.formats: PDF with selectable text, Word (.docx) or a ResumeCraft backup (.json). Up to 10 MB, or 100 MB for a backup.
import.local: Your file is read inside this browser and is not uploaded. Khmer text from some PDF files comes out with characters missing or out of order, so check it carefully. A Word file usually reads better.

problems.unsupported: Choose a PDF, a Word .docx file or a ResumeCraft .json backup. Older .doc files are not supported.
problems.too-large: That file is larger than 10 MB.
problems.too-many-pages: That PDF has more than 15 pages. Choose a resume.
problems.password: That PDF is password protected. Save an unprotected copy and try again.
problems.scanned: No readable text was found. It may be a scan or a picture, which this app cannot read. Try the original Word file, or type the details in the editor.
problems.unreadable: That file could not be read. It may be damaged.

import.truncated: The document is very long, so only the first part was kept.

device.title: Sort on this device
device.body: Free and private. It looks for common headings and dates, so expect to move some things yourself.

gemini.title: Sort with Gemini
gemini.body: Usually more accurate. The text is sent to Google’s Gemini only when you press the button. Your name, email addresses, phone numbers and links are removed first and filled in again on this device. Everything else in the document is sent, including any addresses or names of other people.

Sincerely,
